purpose: Teach: バス停/クリーニング/手袋/長編/投げる/スプレー/植木/団子

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 駅前のバス停、深夜便、増えた。
lines.en: The late-night buses from the station — they've added more of them.
lines.style: Soft observation, like she's noticing something small but real. Slight pause after the dash. Wondering tone, not reporting. Gentle breath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。冬コート、クリーニング、終わった。
lines.en: Yeah. My winter coat is back from the cleaners.
lines.style: Agreeable, light. A small recognition that things are coming together. Natural, not forced brightness. Conversational ease.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お気に入りの手袋、買い替えたい。
lines.en: I really want to get a new pair of my favorite gloves.
lines.style: A bit of longing here, but playful. The kind of want that's half-serious, half-daydreaming. Slight lift at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 長編ドラマ、毎週欠かさず観てるの。
lines.en: I never miss an episode of this long drama series.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact enthusiasm. She means it — this is something she holds to. Not gushing, but definite. A little proud of the loyalty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ゴミ、ゴミ箱に投げる時、外したら、ショック。
lines.en: When I miss the trash can throwing something away, I get this weird embarrassed feeling.
lines.style: Rueful, slightly self-aware humor. She's laughing at herself a little. Quick delivery on the moment of impact, then a small deflating breath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店、消毒スプレー、各テーブルに置いてる。
lines.en: The shop has disinfectant spray stations at every table now.
lines.style: Factual, matter-of-fact. She's noting something practical she's done or observed. No emotion layered in — just information. Efficient clarity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 実家の植木、お父さん、自慢にしてる。
lines.en: My dad is really proud of the plants at home — he shows them off.
lines.style: Tender affection underneath. A soft smile in the voice. She's noticing her father's sweetness without making a big thing of it. Warm, protective.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お土産で、団子セット、買って帰った。
lines.en: I picked up a box of dango as a souvenir and brought it home.
lines.style: Satisfied, warm closure. The detail of care — choosing something specific to bring back. Gentle pace, like the end of a good day. A small contentment.
